name: hologram
prompt: turn my camera into a cyan hologram with scanlines and ghostly echoes while keeping me visible
notes: The camera stays legible under cyan scanlines, a slow roll and a delayed echo. hologram1.uniform1.x is the horizontal wobble, uniform1.y how far the cyan replaces the picture; echo.opacity is how much of the last frame stays. No background removal is implied — the room is still there, just cold.
